metadata.description: Cooling curve benchmark dataset for comparing Newton's law of cooling against the SCFC model. 5 synthetic curves from first-principles physics (Incropera & DeWitt) covering ceramic mug, glass beaker, steel cup, wide bowl with water and coffee at varying humidity.
metadata.generation_method: Synthetic: first-principles physics (Incropera & DeWitt) with Churchill-Chu convection, Stefan-Boltzmann radiation, and ASHRAE evaporation. Gaussian measurement noise (sigma=0.1-0.2°C).
